scope_note: This is the generation-12 corrective pass resolving all 3 reopen findings from PR #5620: (1) Strategy adapter command proof: Eliminated false-success 'metadata_updated' reporting by requiring StrategyCommandAdapter._execute_update_params to independently reload the durable original command receipt from Registry via GET /api/registry/entries/{registry_id}/receipts/{command_id}. Removed duplicate unverified token parser _resolve_caller_actor_id in favor of canonical services.control_plane.bff.command_executor._extract_actor_id. Failed closed with AdapterExecutionError('UNCONFIRMED_COMMAND_RECEIPT') when the receipt cannot be independently confirmed. (2) Keyed generic full-spec revision protocol & lock ordering: Enforced globally consistent lock acquisition order across all writers: advisory_xact_lock(strategy_id) FIRST -> entries.lock_table() SECOND -> receipts.insert_if_absent() THIRD. Eliminated reverse lock order cycle in create_with_receipt. Generic POST /api/registry/entries now extracts strategy_spec and passes strategy_id and validate_lineage to register_with_idempotency, ensuring concurrent typed and keyed revision registrations serialize behind the same advisory lock. Added dual-key receipt indexing in create_with_receipt so receipts can be queried by either register_entry or canonical registry_id. (3) Real PostgreSQL crash-window/response-loss proof & stale contract reconciliation: Implemented real PostgreSQL process-kill and crash-window tests covering create, metadata, and advance in services/registry/test_owner_durability_real_process.py (test_transaction_rollback_before_commit_leaves_no_orphan_reservation_or_state, test_response_loss_crash_window_and_replay_recovery_across_lifecycle) and services/foundation/tests/test_registry_owner_transaction.py (test_transaction_rollback_leaves_no_orphan_reservation_or_state). Reconciled first_release_contract.json statements regarding create_draft receipt and atomic uniqueness.
